name: Myntra HackerRamp WeForShe
description: Participated in Myntra's flagship hackathon HackerRamp WeForShe, focused on building innovative fashion-tech solutions to empower women. Our team developed an AI-powered virtual try-on feature concept with personalized outfit recommendations based on body type and occasion.

name: L'Oréal Brandstorm
description: Participated in L'Oréal Brandstorm, a global innovation competition focusing on sustainable beauty technology. Developed a concept for a personalized skincare recommendation app using IoT skin-analysis sensors integrated with a mobile application ecosystem.
